sourceEnglishObjective: Ask workers to prevent and report deck damage
sourceEnglishSpeaking: Stop a worker who is about to cover a soft panel and request a repair.
candidateObjective: 柔らかい下地や損傷を見つけ、補修が必要だと伝える。
candidateFocus: ～ないでください tells someone not to cover a panel; ～たら知らせてください requests a report if a condition is found. ～前に identifies what must happen before work continues.

archivedForms.exampleJa: 作業班は今日、屋根下地を補修します。
archivedForms.exampleEnglish: The crew repairs the deck today.

archivedForms.exampleJa: 作業員は損傷した場所に印を付けます。
archivedForms.exampleEnglish: The worker marks the damaged area.

作業員は柔らかい板材を覆いません。

archivedSpeaking.opening: ここで止めてください。屋根下地が柔らかいので、補修が必要です。
archivedSpeaking.goal: Stop a worker who is about to cover a soft panel and request a repair.

curriculumAdaptationNote: Preserve the current tear-off scene: prevent sheathing damage, report soft or damaged structural deck, discover rotten wood by stepping on a panel, stop before covering, mark damage and replace plywood. Do not turn a soft structural panel into generic soft material or change felt rot to a visual guess. The source curriculum has no authored verb example list; archived forms remain conditional evidence. Archived draft is not selected learner/audio text and creates no score, saved-item or progress identity.

cards.reviewNote: Archived 野地板 may narrow sheathing/forro de techo to structural roof boards. Confirm the roof assembly and Japanese trade term before selection.

cards.archivedJapanese: 柔らかくなった屋根下地
cards.reviewNote: The Spanish source says soft or rotten deck; archived 柔らかくなった屋根下地 may omit the rotten condition and may refer to underlayment rather than the structural deck.
Panel is archived as 板材 (board/material); confirm whether this preserves a deck panel rather than a loose board.
